user.description: Raise pylutron-caseta's LEAP read limit from 256 KiB to 4 MiB, so large Lutron systems whose replies exceed 256 KiB can connect. Lutron Caseta picks it up on its next reconnect.

incompatible.title: Lutron LEAP Limit can't apply its change
incompatible.description: pylutron-caseta's connection function no longer takes a read limit, so this integration does nothing. Check whether large Lutron systems still need it; if not, remove it.

not_needed.title: Lutron LEAP Limit is no longer needed
not_needed.description: pylutron-caseta now reads up to {limit} bytes per reply on its own, which is at least what this integration sets. You can remove it.
